mapper.sql: id, user_id, record_id, stage, status, turn_count, stage_reask_count, last_active_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_session ( user_id, record_id, stage, status, turn_count, stage_reask_count, last_active_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{recordId}, #{stage}, #{status}, #{turnCount}, #{stageReaskCount}, #{lastActiveAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM agent_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
AND record_id = #{recordId}
AND record_id IS NULL
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
